'''Kurline''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] shipping manager and the administrator of the [[Sailor's Union]] [[Landing Union chapter]] circa [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].

==Biography==
Circa [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the [[Sailor's Union]] was a strong institution in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Its headquarters in [[Farsands]], capital city of [[Little Mon Cal]], was managed by the crafty shipping manager Kurline, a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].

Kurline was well-liked and supported, as he fought for the rights of the sailors. He also met with Union members whenever anyone asked, and sometimes interviewed potential new members. Sometimes, Kurline accepted bribes.

==Personality and traits==
Kurline was familiar with information about the Union and about Lamaredd. He was fluent in [[Chagri/Legends|Chagri]], [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]], and [[Quarrenese/Legends|Quarrenese]].

Kurline liked expensive clothes. He commonly carried with him a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Credit chip/Legends|credstick]], and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. His weapons of choice were a knife and a hold-out slugthrower.
